title: Aktenablage: Option, grosse Dokumente zu loeschen
cause: No such feature. Archiving a case (chkArchived in ArchiveFilePanel) never looks at document sizes, a new suggestion dialog listing large images/videos/documents with delete actions would be needed.
maintainer: Raw idea by j-dimension himself (2026-10-29), no details.
notes: Thresholds, file types, recycle bin vs hard delete and when to show the dialog are all undecided. New dialog, not a small PR.

title: Switch JDBC connections to caching_sha2_password (MySQL 8.4/9)
cause: Backup manager JDBC URL uses sslMode=DISABLED without allowPublicKeyRetrieval, which fails for caching_sha2_password users on first login. Server datasources live in installer/Docker standalone.xml (Docker uses the MariaDB driver). Connector is 8.2.0
maintainer: Own task list (2026-10-28): decide and document TLS vs public key retrieval, update datasources, installer scripts, migration notes, test MySQL 8.0/8.4/MariaDB
notes: Maintainer epic opened two days ago, decision pending and most work is in installers outside this repo. The backupmgr URL part could become a small PR once he picks the approach

title: Aktenanlage: Vorbelegung Sachbearbeiter / Anwalt konfigurierbar
cause: ArchiveFilePanel.clearInputs() hard-codes the presets for a new case: lawyer = current user (only if isLawyer()), assistant = current user. There is no configurable default like the per-user primaryGroup preset for group and authorized groups.
maintainer: Should be configurable, analogous to the existing per-user preset of group and authorized groups.
notes: Config location (user admin vs own profile) and storage (UserSettings key-value store, no schema change, vs new AppUserBean column) are not decided. Small once that is settled.

title: Spalten Akten-/Adresssuche konfigurierbar (inkl. Eigene Felder)
cause: Both search panels build fixed colNames arrays (e.g. QuickArchiveFileSearchPanel line ~742) and fixed table models. The table model is shared with other panels (ArchiveFileReviewsMissingPanel). custom1-3 exist on ArchiveFileBean/AddressBean but are not shown.
notes: Column chooser + per-user persistence + custom fields in two search panels, modelled on the configurable document table from 5bbc007de. Large new UI feature, not one small PR.

title: Windows 11: invisible dialogs pile up behind the main window
cause: Not located. Maintainer suspects the per-document name prompts of copyOrMoveDocumentsToOtherCase (FileUtils.getNewFileName, see #3345), reporter denies copying. ReminderNotificationDialog is a reused singleton, so it is not the culprit
maintainer: Cannot reproduce despite daily 10h use, asks for the sequence of actions that creates the windows
notes: No repro steps, Windows 11 specific window ordering. Reporter later says they are dialogs that accumulate during the day. Possible relation to #3345

title: Dropscan: mehrere Scans als 1 PDF herunterladen
cause: The Dropscan tab in ScannerPanel imports one mailing at a time through DropscanEntryProcessor, there is no multi-select merge. PDFBox PDFMergerUtility is already used in EpostPdfMergeStep and ExportAsPdfMergeStep.
maintainer: Merge on the client side (Dropscan web UI reportedly has such a function).
notes: The merge itself is easy, but verifying needs a live Dropscan account and API downloads. Order of pages and destroy-after-import for the merged mailings also need a decision.

title: Dateinamen beim Kopieren/Verschieben von Dokumenten beibehalten
cause: ArchiveFilePanel.copyOrMoveDocumentsToOtherCase() calls FileUtils.getNewFileName() once per selected document with applyNameTemplate=move, so every document gets a dialog and a move also applies the name template. The server copyDocumentsToCase/moveDocumentsToCase already falls back to the source name when no new name is given.
notes: Client-only change in one method: for a multi-selection ask once whether to keep the existing names, skip the per-document dialog and template, and fall back to the dialog only on a name clash (doesDocumentExist), since addDocumentImpl throws on duplicates. UI pattern (one upfront question vs a 'fuer alle' option) should be confirmed with j-dimension. Not endorsed by the maintainer yet.

title: Ingo chat: final answer shown above the tool call notices
cause: AssistantChatPanel.startBackgroundTask adds the placeholder incomingMsgPanel right after the user message, then appends the ToolCallGroupPanel with pnlMessages.add(activeToolGroup) below it and finally writes the answer into incomingMsgPanel, so the answer sits above the tools. Fix by inserting the group at the z-order index of incomingMsgPanel (or moving the panel below the group)
notes: Still present after 9fe6fb8e0 (2026-10-30, grouped and collapsible tool calls), which kept the append order. Reopened stored chats (AiChatTranscript.toEntries) already show tools before the answer, so only the live view is inconsistent. Maintainer is actively working in this file, coordinate to avoid conflicts

title: Falldaten (FDB) optional durchsuchbar machen
cause: ArchiveFileService.searchEnhanced() only matches name, fileNumber, filenumberext, reason, custom1-3, subjectField, lawyer, assistant and tags, form plugin data (case_forms entries) is not searched.
maintainer: Implementation unclear, maybe a switch in the case search to include form data.
notes: Maintainer explicitly says the implementation is unclear (switch in search UI, SQL join vs Lucene index). Performance of joining form entries also needs care.

title: Text einer Notiz in Dokument uebernehmen (wie Sprachmemo)
cause: The note viewer HtmlPanel (created in DocumentViewerFactory for .html) has no 'neues Dokument' action and gets no DocumentPreviewSaveCallback, unlike SoundplayerPanel.cmdNewDocumentActionPerformed(), which passes the transcript as ingoText to EditArchiveFileDetailsPanel.newDocumentDialog() for {{INGO_TEXT}}.
maintainer: Issue written by j-dimension: transfer note text without the header into documents, like the voice memo function.
notes: Behaviour defined by analogy with the existing voice memo button. Header = the table + <hr/> that AddNoteFrame prepends, so strip up to the first <hr> and convert HTML to plain text with paragraph breaks (Jsoup), which is a unit-testable helper. LibreOfficeAccess already handles multi-paragraph INGO_TEXT. Needs the .form update. iradraconis' context-menu/Ingo idea overlaps #2934 and should stay out of scope.

title: Etikett ueber Desktop direkt entfernen koennen
cause: Desktop tagged entries (TaggedEntryPanelTransparent) only open the case on click, there is no context menu or action to remove a tag.
maintainer: Issue by j-dimension with empty body.
notes: UI undecided: an entry can show several matching tags, case tags vs document tags (TaggedEntry.documentId), multi-value tags, confirmation and refresh of the Tagged panel. Would be close to F once a 'context menu per shown tag' design is agreed, Swing only and not headless-testable.

title: Wiedervorlagen kategorisieren
cause: ArchiveFileReviewsBean has eventType, summary, assignee, calendarSetup and reminder fields but no category.
notes: Needs a new column (schema change) or a product decision to reuse calendar entry templates or tags as categories, plus a batch-processing view for one category.

title: Handhabung von Dateien > 2GB
cause: Document content is passed around as byte[] (ServerFileUtils.readFile, getDocumentContent, addDocument), limited to Integer.MAX_VALUE. Only the DataBucket path (getDocumentContentBucket) streams in chunks.
maintainer: Issue by j-dimension: a solution without the byte-array limit has to be designed.
notes: Architectural change across EJB API, client and storage. Related to openspec change add-document-encryption-at-rest (C5 DataBucket streaming path, explicitly notes the 2 GB cap).

title: Standardordner fuer Notizen
cause: AddNoteFrame.cmdAddDocumentActionPerformed() calls addDocument(caseId, name, bytes, "", null) without any folder, so new notes always land in the case root folder. No default-folder setting exists anywhere.
maintainer: Issue by j-dimension: per-user or global setting for the folder of new notes.
notes: User vs global setting, folder resolution by name in each case tree and behaviour when the folder is missing (create or root) are undecided.

title: Erweiterte Sprecherbenennung bei Transkription
cause: SoundplayerPanel.processOutput() puts the transcript from the external Ingo backend verbatim into taTranscription, speaker labels like 'SPRECHER 1' are produced there and the client offers no rename or search/replace.
notes: Two variants proposed (suggest names from case parties vs simple search/replace). The label format is defined by the external Ingo service. A small 'Sprecher umbenennen' dialog would be feasible once a variant is chosen.

title: Multiwindow fuer Sprachmemo-Funktion
cause: AddVoiceMemoDialog is a modal JDialog (modal=true in ArchiveFilePanel.cmdAddVoiceMemoActionPerformed and SoundplayerPanel continue-recording), the caller reads getMemoBytes() synchronously after setVisible(), which blocks the case window while recording.
notes: Follow-up of #2940, where notes became the non-modal AddNoteFrame registered via EditorsRegistry.registerFrame. Same refactor needed here (dialog saves to the captured case itself). Open points: switching or closing the case while recording, the continue-recording path. M-sized Swing refactor, not headless-verifiable, so not F.

title: Messenger: Nachrichtenpriorisierung
cause: InstantMessage has no priority field (only sent, sender, content, case and document context, mentions).
notes: Needs a new DB column plus UI for selection, highlighting, filter and a separate tab.

title: Termin in mehrere Kalender eintragen
cause: ArchiveFileReviewsBean references exactly one CalendarSetup and the event dialogs offer a single calendar selection.
notes: Could be done client-side by creating one independent event per selected calendar, but linked vs independent copies, later edit/delete and cloud sync need a decision. Touches the area of openspec change add-bidirectional-nextcloud-calendar-sync.

title: Schlagworte / Notiz an Dokument (Rest: Kategorie/Dokumentart)
cause: All checklist items except 'Kategorie / Dokumentart' were delivered by 5bbc007de (title, keywords, received date, correspondent, parent hierarchy, list display, keyword suggestions). A category maintained in settings can already be modelled as a document multi-value tag (document.tags.mv.Dokumentart, multi-value tags since 225cd99c6).
maintainer: j-dimension updated the checklist on 2026-09-29 and left only the category item open.
notes: Mostly done. Remaining item needs a decision: close it in favour of document multi-value tags, or add a dedicated category field (schema change, X).

title: Messaging: Nachricht mit Referenzen auf mehrere Dokumente
cause: InstantMessage.documentContext is a single @ManyToOne on column document_id.
notes: Needs a new join table (Flyway migration), API changes and messenger UI changes.

title: Weitere Ingo-Funktionen bei Notizen
cause: AddNoteFrame and HtmlPanel only use Ingo transcription (REQUESTTYPE_TRANSCRIBE), while SendEmailFrame builds popAssistant via AssistantAccess.populateMenu for GENERATE, EXPLAIN, SUMMARIZE, TRANSLATE and CHAT.
notes: Mirroring the e-mail Ingo menu in the note editor (button, AssistantInputAdapter, result insertion) is feasible but M-sized with .form changes. The concrete prompts (Antworten, Briefkopf, DeepL) are server-side Ingo configuration. Scope and placement undecided. Overlaps the context-menu idea in #3258.

title: Ingo-Transkription auch fuer AAC und Opus
cause: The client decodes only MP3 and OGG Vorbis to WAV via javax.sound SPIs (AudioConvertUtils, PR #3624 merged as 679ca2fe9). AAC was dropped because the JAAD forks hijack all AudioSystem calls, Opus has no Java Sound provider at all.
maintainer: Prefers server-side conversion with ffmpeg on the WildFly host (precedent LibreOffice), alternative codec-only client libs called per file extension. Keeps the ticket open for AAC/Opus.
notes: New server-side system dependency or substantial own codec code, needs ffmpeg in the test environment. Not a small PR.

title: macOS: clicks in the document list often not recognised
cause: Likely cause: list-view selection runs in mouseClicked handlers (lblFileNameMouseClicked and siblings) on labels that also carry drag gesture recognizers. On macOS any pointer movement between press and release (Magic Mouse, sensitive mice) suppresses mouseClicked, so the click is lost. Handling selection on mousePressed or mouseReleased with a small tolerance would avoid it
notes: Only verifiable on macOS hardware (Linux works per commenter). The table view (CaseDocumentsTable, JTable selection on press) is a workaround. b8d672171 (2026-10-27) touched the same handler for the context menu

title: Akte loeschen nur nach Passworteingabe / geschuetzte Akten
cause: Case deletion (QuickArchiveFileSearchPanel -> ArchiveFileService.removeArchiveFile) only needs removeArchiveFileRole, group access and a yes/no confirmation dialog.
maintainer: Issue by j-dimension, optional idea: mark cases as protected and prevent deletion.
notes: Password re-entry vs protected flag is a product decision. A protected flag needs a new column (X). Password re-check must be enforced server-side to be meaningful.

title: Backup restore fails on MariaDB with utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci collation
cause: RestoreExecutor.restoreDatabase sources jlawyerdb-dump.sql unchanged via the mysql CLI. Dumps from MySQL 8 carry utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci for tables created with only DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4, which older MariaDB rejects. Add a streaming rewrite of utf8mb4_0900_* to utf8mb4_unicode_ci (only when the target reports MariaDB) before sourcing the dump
maintainer: Fix either by avoiding such collations or by replacing them in the backup manager, e.g. sed s/utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci/utf8mb4_unicode_ci/g on the dump
notes: Replacement helper is unit-testable. Avoiding the collation would need migrations (X). Newer MariaDB releases (10.11.11, 11.4.5 and later, to be verified) accept utf8mb4_0900_* as aliases, which lowers urgency. Dump can be large, so stream instead of reading into memory

title: WildFly log cleanup does not work (logs grow without limit)
cause: 20b29d392 (2023-11-29) replaced the size-rotating-file-handler with max-backup-index 20 by a periodic-rotating-file-handler without any backup limit in docker/wildfly/standalone.xml, so daily server.log files are never pruned. The same file sets org.wildfly.security to TRACE, which inflates the logs
maintainer: Own note: try size-rotating-file-handler with rotate-size 100m and max-backup-index 5 for server.log and access_log
notes: Only the Docker config is in this repo. The installer standalone.xml lives elsewhere and existing installs are not updated. Needs a running WildFly to verify. A docker-only config PR would be S if the maintainer wants it

title: Case header without line wrap pushes buttons off screen on laptops
cause: In ArchiveFilePanel.initComponents lblHeaderInfo (file number + Kurzrubrum + wegen) is added to the horizontal group with default sizes, so its minimum width equals the full text width and forces the whole panel wider than the window. Set min size 0 in the .form/.java (JLabel then truncates with an ellipsis) and put the full text in a tooltip, or wrap via HTML
notes: Duplicate of #1323 (same cause, one PR closes both). Editor pane is no longer a scroll pane, so the overflow is clipped. Must keep the .form in sync for the NetBeans GUI builder

title: New case: lawyer, assistant and subject field lost after next new case
cause: Not confirmed. The three fields are exactly those clearInputs() resets (cmbLawyer, cmbAssistant, cmbSubjectField). Suspect path: confirmSave() keeps the saved case in the singleton NewArchiveFilePanel (setArchiveFileDTO), and re-selecting New Case returns early in EditorsRegistry.setMainEditorsPaneView (same component, no reset), so later edits and saves can hit the saved case
notes: Exact click sequence and version unknown (2024), no maintainer reply. Needs a reproducible sequence before a fix

title: Logo and wordmark on splash/login look blurry
cause: LoginDialog shows /images/j-lawyer-logo-125px.png (125x102 raster), which gets upscaled and blurred under OS display scaling. Needs a higher-resolution or vector asset (multi-resolution image or SVG icon)
notes: Cosmetic, depends on a design asset from the project, not a code bug

title: No scrolling of the folder list while dragging documents into folders
cause: Each FolderListCell registers its own DropTarget with an empty dragOver() and neither the cells nor FoldersListPanel implement java.awt.dnd.Autoscroll. Native DnD swallows mouse wheel events on Windows/Linux, so folders outside the viewport are unreachable. Implement edge autoscroll (Autoscroll interface or dragOver near the viewport edge calling scrollRectToVisible)
notes: Commenter proposes auto-scroll at the top/bottom edge, works already on macOS. Scroll-step logic can live in a small testable helper, manual check on Linux/Windows. Same file as the already covered FolderListCell.drop() fix, sequence the PRs. Related to #2781

title: Messaging area lacks a heading
cause: Unclear which view the screenshot shows. MessagingCenterPanel has had the title Nachrichten since its first version f18b2f740 (2023-09-19), so it is likely another messaging area (case tab or desktop)
notes: Labelled question, cosmetic, location and expected heading unclear without the screenshot

title: Contacts: encryption label at top right touches the window edge
cause: The top-level horizontal group in AddressPanel.initComponents only has a leading addContainerGap() and no trailing gap (the .form lacks the closing EmptySpace), so jPanel23 with chkEncryption/lblEncryption and the tab pane run flush to the right edge. ArchiveFilePanel has the trailing gap
maintainer: Asked whether OS scaling is used (reporter: 105 percent on Windows 10)
notes: One EmptySpace in the .form plus addContainerGap() in the generated code. Cosmetic but trivially reviewable

title: Server does not listen on IPv6
cause: WildFly is started with -Djava.net.preferIPv4Stack=true (WildFly default and docker/wildfly/standalone.conf), so all sockets bind to 0.0.0.0 only. This is installer/runtime configuration, not j-lawyer code
notes: Installer configs are not in this repo, needs an IPv6 or dual-stack environment to verify. Client launchers also force preferIPv4Stack (related #1881)

title: RAM monitor counts page cache as used, constant warnings on Linux
cause: SystemMonitorTask.getPhysicalMemStatusLevel and SystemManagement.getMonitoringSnapshot use OperatingSystemMXBean.getFreePhysicalMemorySize(), which on Linux returns MemFree (sysinfo freeram) and so counts buffers/cache as used. Read MemAvailable from /proc/meminfo on Linux (fallback to the MXBean) in one shared helper
maintainer: RAM check can be disabled. An external library apparently counts buffered RAM as used (it is actually the JDK MXBean)
notes: Code unchanged since the initial commit 674bb3ade. Parsing /proc/meminfo is unit-testable. The two duplicated calculations should share the helper

title: Calendar: case changes (Rubrum) not pushed to Nextcloud events
cause: CalendarSyncService.getEventSummary/getEventDescription embed file number, name, reason and lawyer of the case, but ArchiveFileService.updateArchiveFile never calls calendarSync.eventUpdated for the open events (it only fires CaseUpdatedEvent, observed solely by CustomHooksService). Only the optional twice-daily full sync would refresh them
notes: Fix: inject CalendarSyncServiceLocal and push open reviews when these fields changed (capture old values before edit). Change-detection helper unit-testable, end-to-end check needs a Nextcloud (Docker). Touches the same service as openspec add-bidirectional-nextcloud-calendar-sync, which does not cover this case

title: Long Kurzrubrum/wegen widens the case editor, labels unreachable
cause: Same as #2448: lblHeaderInfo has minimum width = text width in the ArchiveFilePanel GroupLayout, so the panel grows beyond the screen and tags/buttons are cut off without a scrollbar
notes: Duplicate of #2448 (older report). Fix both in one PR (min size 0 plus tooltip or wrapping)

title: Owner group and permissions can be overwritten from a stale open case
cause: Owner-only editing of group and allowed groups is enforced only in the client at load time (ArchiveFileDetailLoadAction sets tblGroups/cmbGroups enabled). updateArchiveFile and updateAllowedGroups only call SecurityUtils.checkGroupsForCase, which accepts owner OR allowed groups, so a user with an outdated view can save the old group/permissions
maintainer: Scenario 5 is a bug: on save the server must check whether the user may still change it. Without an owner group there is intentionally no access protection, docs should say so
notes: Only scenario 5 is a code bug, the rest is documentation or by design. Add an owner check (owner group null or caller member) when group or allowed groups change, mirroring the client rule. Security sensitive, check REST v1/v2 and BulkEditCasePermissions paths

title: Documents: inconsistent context menu actions on multi-selection
cause: Partly fixed: copy/move to another case now handles all selected documents. Still open: mnuRenameDocumentActionPerformed silently returns when more than one document is selected and mnuOpenDocumentActionPerformed opens only get(0), while showDocumentsPopup never disables these single-document items for multi-selection
notes: Minimal fix: in showDocumentsPopup enable rename/open only for a single selection (keeping the readOnly/archived rule from setReadOnly). Opening all selected is a UX choice, disabling is the safe option
